title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Documentation Terms: Documents Accepted as Proof of Income or Need, by Tier
content:
Each tier of the Patient Financial Assistance Program names the document types that prove income or need for that tier, whether income documents are required before a decision, and the limits on particular documents.

## Whether income documents are required, and which documents are accepted

| Tier | Income documents required before a decision | Document types accepted as proof of income or need |
|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | Yes | Federal tax return; pay stubs; Social Security benefit letter; unemployment benefit statement; zero-income attestation |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | Yes | Federal tax return; pay stubs; Social Security benefit letter; unemployment benefit statement; zero-income attestation |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | Yes | Federal tax return; pay stubs; Social Security benefit letter; unemployment benefit statement; zero-income attestation |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | Yes | Federal tax return; pay stubs; Social Security benefit letter; unemployment benefit statement; zero-income attestation |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | No | Proof of program enrollment |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | Yes | Federal tax return; pay stubs; Social Security benefit letter; unemployment benefit statement; medical expense statement |

## Limits on particular documents

| Tier | Signed zero-income attestation accepted as income documentation | Calendar days of most recent pay stubs required | Most recent filed tax years accepted | Medicaid screening line, percent of the poverty guideline |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | Yes | 30 | 1 | 0 (no screening) |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | Yes | 30 | 1 | 0 (no screening) |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | Yes | 30 | 1 | 0 (no screening) |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | Yes | 30 | 1 | 138 |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (no screening) |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | No | 30 | 1 | 0 (no screening) |

## Notes

- **Pay stubs.** Where pay stubs are accepted, they must cover the most recent 30 calendar days, and income from them is annualized from that 30-day period.
- **Tax returns.** Where a tax return is accepted, only the single most recent filed tax year counts.
- **Medicaid screening line.** Only the Financial Assistance Full Discount carries a screening line, at 138 percent of the poverty guideline: an uninsured applicant at or below that line must also show a Medicaid application or a Medicaid denial before approval. A line of 0 means no screening applies to the tier.
- **Zero-income attestation.** The four income tiers accept a signed zero-income attestation; the Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount and the Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment do not.
